about_the_game:
Tomb of the Bloodletter is a strategic word game roguelike that transforms your keyboard into an array of powerful and deadly abilities! Form words using tactical combinations of your letters' powers to defeat the denizens of this dingy tomb, and claim the Bloodletter for yourself...

Your journey begins with a single word...

At the start of each floor of the Tomb, you'll craft a word to form the map you'll be traversing. Do you want powerful tools or to increase your Magick rerolls? You can have both if you can devise a word that allows it! 

A mighty roster of terrible fiends!

The Tomb is crawling with all manner of hostile beast, and you'll have to use every ounce of your tactical and verbal acumen to overcome their dastardly tricks!

Choose your graverobber!

The final game will feature 4 unique playable characters, each shaking up the rules of the game and adding new layers of depth to the Tomb.
